newsitem.title: USA: Newhall Land boosts unit buyback.
newsitem.headline: Newhall Land boosts unit buyback.

text.p: The Newhall Land and Farming Co on Wednesday said it raised its unit buyback plan to 2.0 million units from the current 1.5 million units.

Under the new plan, 510,022 units will be repurchased. Units will be purchased from time to time in the open market. The company currently has 34,700,726 units outstanding. The expanded program will be funded primarily by ranch land sales.

Newhall Land also declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.10 a share, which is unchanged from the previous quarter, and it set a special cash dividend of $0.08 a share. Dividends are payable March 10 to shareholders of record on Feb. 7.
